name: St John the Evangelist Church Hall
summary: A well-kept hall behind the parish church in Withycombe.
description: Tucked behind the parish church in Withycombe, this hall is a well-used local fixture — home to regular community groups through the week and available to hire for parties, wakes and other gatherings at weekends. It is fully accessible, with well-equipped kitchens and an accessible toilet with baby changing.
